summary_en: Kamgras 1 K.K. (offeror) amends its tender offer for Kakaku.com shares effective 2026-06-03 following shortening of Foreign Exchange Act waiting period. Tender offer commenced 2026-05-13. Amended filing addresses timing of when ordinary shares became acquirable; no change to offer terms or conditions.
title_en: Notice regarding correction to tender offer announcement following submission of corrected tender offer filing by Kamgras 1 K.K.
translation_en_brief: Kamgras 1 K.K. announced on 2026-06-04 a correction to its tender offer for Kakaku.com Inc. (TSE Prime, code 2371). The tender offer was initiated on 2026-05-13. The correction follows a shortening of the Foreign Exchange Act waiting period on 2026-06-02, which enabled acquisition of Kakaku.com ordinary shares from 2026-06-03 onward. The filer states this correction does not constitute a change to offer terms or conditions under the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act. The amendment updates certain disclosures in the tender offer filing and initial tender offer announcement filed on 2026-05-13 (as previously corrected on 2026-05-19 and 2026-05-27). The notice confirms withdrawal conditions remain as previously disclosed.
